title: Riverfront Condo Stay with Balcony, Near Downtown
description:
Settle into this two-bedroom, two-bath riverfront condo in downtown Nashville. The furnished balcony and river view give you an inviting place to unwind, while fast Wi-Fi, central air, a full kitchen, and a dedicated workspace make longer stays easy. The home sleeps up to eight guests with a king bed, two double beds, and a sofa bed.

The space
Make your way to this stylish, single-level condo in Music City for the ultimate Nashville experience! Located on the second-floor and offering fantastic river and rail bridge views, this sunlit vacation rental features a well-equipped, stainless steel kitchen for preparing everything from your morning Java to full-course dinners, a dining table for mealtimes or game nights, and a comfortably-furnished living area with a flatscreen TV. And outside on your furnished and covered balcony, close out your days with cocktails, good company, and Cumberland River vistas.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.
